name: Sports
description: Percentages from the games people argue about hardest.

facts.statement: NBA players make about 78% of their free throws
facts.short: the share of NBA free throws that go in

facts.statement: NFL kickers make about 85% of their field goal attempts
facts.short: the share of NFL field goals that go through

facts.statement: About 76% of penalty kicks in professional football are scored
facts.short: the share of penalties that go in

facts.statement: The average Major League batter hits about .248, so he fails three times in four
facts.short: how often a big-league hitter actually hits

facts.statement: Professional tennis players land about 60% of their first serves
facts.short: the share of first serves that land in

facts.statement: The home team wins about 45% of Premier League matches
facts.short: the home team's share of wins

facts.statement: About 1.6% of college football players are drafted into the NFL
facts.short: the share of college players who turn professional

facts.statement: About 7% of American high school athletes go on to play in college at any level
facts.short: the share of school athletes who play in college

facts.statement: NBA teams make about 36% of their three-point attempts
facts.short: the share of three-pointers that drop

facts.statement: About a quarter of Premier League matches end in a draw
facts.short: the share of matches nobody wins

facts.statement: The marathon world record pace is roughly twice the speed of an average recreational runner
facts.short: how much faster the record holder runs

facts.statement: About half of all sports injuries seen in clinics are overuse injuries, not accidents
facts.short: the share of sports injuries caused by repetition
